reviews.title: The app
reviews.text: Yeah the app has a problem. Literally cannot open it, every time i try to use it it closes immediately. I’ve deleted it and re-downloaded it. Downloaded on different devices, restarted my phone. None of it works. The app is not it.

reviews.title: Rest timer notif vibration ISSUE
reviews.text: It’s only vibrating when screen turns on and haptics are always on! I believe it’s unfixable by you guys. Thanks for the nice app which it isn’t now!

reviews.title: Was good
reviews.text: New update make app unable to be opened.

reviews.title: PLEASE FIX THIS PLEASE! 🙏🏻
reviews.text: iPhone 13 Pro using latest Lyfta app. Rest timer notifications are not vibrating neither on apple watch, just the sound and the issue continues on iOS 27 as well.

reviews.title: Not free
reviews.text: App says it’s free but it isn’t once you get to the end.

reviews.title: buggy
reviews.text: Completed workout yesterday, got final screen with total weight, etc. Today it shows as missed.

reviews.title: NOT FREE
reviews.text: Seen the reviews saying it was free and was excited to download. Upon actually downloading app and going through the sign up process, once I get to the last page it says it’s free for 2 weeks and then $60/year. Such a waste of time.

reviews.title: Disgusting
reviews.text: I should not scroll through a workout app and see “Gestapo amazing”. Do you have any idea how offensive that is? I refuse to use this app or recommend it to anyone based on the insensitivity and disgusting nature of including such a workout. You should be ashamed.

reviews.title: Deceiving
reviews.text: Yet another app that suggests there are some simple, free capabilities but then forces you to pay and subscribe after a trial period. Why not make a great app with limited free features and then make it a no brainer that I should upgrade to a paid plan. Just awful.

reviews.title: Not “free” as advertised
reviews.text: As soon as you create a login and answer questions about your goals, you’re  required to start a subscription. The description in the AppStore stated this was a free workout tracker. It is not. False advertising.

reviews.title: Fake advertising
reviews.text:
Advertising is free work up but after install give you 14 days free trial then 49.99 a year
Waste of time installing plus you can use the 14 days free after you submit for payment not  before.

reviews.title: NOT FREE
reviews.text: Another scam so that’s free until you actually want to use it. Unless you want to pay $60 don’t download this.

reviews.title: Don’t get duped
reviews.text: This app is full of typos, workouts in languages I don’t know, and uses cutesy anime images to describe workout programs. I expected a lot more given the reviews I read. And those hundreds of “free” programs… I never saw any of those. Canceled within 24 hours. Total junk.

reviews.title: Would Have Been Great
reviews.text: Would have but each time you attempt to save exercises into a workout, they don't save. It's so frustrating that you just give up. Nice app but if I can't quickly save my exercises, then it's pointless. I'll wait to see what updates are made.

reviews.title: Security and internet connection issues
reviews.text: I already sent review yesterday but it disappeared without explanation. Please explain to me why it wouldn’t get published? To summarize, my antivirus software keeps blocking it saying that it could harm my device and steal data. I cannot see the workout videos in the app since it says that I am offline even though I am not.

reviews.text: I got charged on accident and they won’t return the money 🫠

reviews.title: Mediocrity
reviews.text: Usability is poor, dozens of clicks and presses to manually create a program. Poor creation and management of programs. Did someone knock this up in a weekend with AI ? Possibly.

reviews.title: not reliable
reviews.text: i used this since june. has work amazing until now. it wont load and freezes and wont let me track workouts now i dont know how my progress is going. VERY ANNOYING!!
